translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: 1 Timote
book.title: 1 Timote Maktumne ta awalle taat Pool siiriiji ɗo Timote

content: Min gamin okin̰co, maan kaak awalle nu rakiy gee yaa gine-ak a ŋuu indiguwe Buŋ ɗo gee okin̰co, ŋuuco salkiyguwe iŋ loklikin̰co ho ŋuu ozilguwin̰ji ɗo bi kan̰co.

Salkiyguwoŋ ɗo sultinniidi ho ɗo ŋuur okin̰co kuuk hokumiyaw. Paa kat, gii goye iŋ aapiye, bal kaawo, ho ɗo ay maanna, gii gaare iŋ goyinte kadar gi karmiya Buŋ ho gii goye sellen̰ ɗo uŋco ka geemir oki.
Ŋaar-aŋ ko maan kaak sellen̰ ho kaak samaane ɗo uŋji ka Buŋ kaak jilaate.
Ŋa raka a gee okin̰co yaa gase jile ho ŋuu ibinin seeney.
Ka seener, Buŋ, ŋaar rakki di ho gem rakki di goy ɗatik ta Buŋ iŋ gee. Gem-ak, ŋaar ko Iisa Masi.
Ŋaar kaak ber ziy *satkine a ŋaa jilin̰ gee okin̰co. Ŋaar-aŋ ko maan kaak as ɗo wiktiney kaak gaara kadar Buŋ raka jile gee.
Ɗo bi ŋaar-ak ko, Buŋ diyintu gay gaare kaawor ho *paliine. Nu raadɗo, nu kaawa seene. Ŋa diyintu a naa ɓildin̰ gee kuuk Yuudinnaɗo ɗo bi ka imaan taat ɗo Buŋdi ho ɗo seeney.
Maman miday iŋ daaɗi yaa goye ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi
Ampa-ak, ɗo ay wero, nu raka miday yaa salkiyguwe, ŋuu jaalguwe pisin̰co

Nu raka oki a daaɗi yaa isguwe kesuun taat kuuniye ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi ho taat icaaɗo odin ku midir. Ŋu siyaaɗo ziŋkico iŋ dee ka duruwco kaak arro. Ŋu isguwenno daabne ɗo ziŋkico, wala ɗuura, wala kesuun taat kaalin aale.
Kar gay, ŋuu gaarguwe samaanuwco iŋ gamin kuuk samaane ŋu gingiyo kuuk tur ɗo daaɗ kuuk karmiya Buŋ.
Ɗo wiktin ta bilɗindi, daaɗ yaa goyguwe iŋ bugumco di ho ŋuu cokiyguwe iŋ karaamine.
Nu balco bere izinne ɗo daatir taat ŋuu ɓilde miday wal ŋuu goye kaaco. Kar gay, illa ŋuu goye iŋ bugumco di.
Nu kaawiy pa-ak asaan Buŋ kilgiyig ja Aadum, kar kat astu Hawwa.
Kar pey Aadum bal rase ziy *Seetanne yaaji un̰je berkile, kar daatik kat ras ziti, Seetanne un̰jiitit berkile ho ta nigtu ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi.
Iŋ taar-at ko, daatko-at yaa gase jile iŋ weenti. Kar daaɗ okin̰co gay yaa gase jile-ak ya ŋu ob tirit ɗo imaanco, ɗo elin̰co, ho ɗo goyin̰co kaak *cawar ho kaak tur ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi.

footnotes.text: ‛jaalguwe pisin̰co’ : Ya Yuudinna salkiyaw, ŋu jaala pisin̰co.
Wer ka gase kaawor ɗo Soom 134.2, Lamantasiyon 2.19.
